description: This file contains a PHP class named Banner within the Opencart.Admin.Controller.Design namespace. It handles various functionalities related to banners in the OpenCart administrative interface, including listing, editing, creating, and deleting banners. The class extends a core Controller class and interfaces with models and views to implement the banner management features.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Represents the Banner management controller in the OpenCart admin panel, responsible for listing, editing, creating, and deleting banner records.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of banners with pagination, sorting, and filtering options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Displays the list of banners by returning the view generated by getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for rendering the banner list view, including sorting, pagination, and banner data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a banner.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated banner data to the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected banners, checking user permissions and returning JSON status.
